name: EPIC 201567710
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 5.8 solar radii and 0.85 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201567710 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 5.7963 (16th-84th percentiles 5.668465-5.975247), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201567710 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.851318 (16th-84th percentiles 0.80505-0.919969), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201567710: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4840.227 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201567710 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3536.679688 (16th-84th percentiles 3464.84375-3622.96875), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.01 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,537 parsecs away, 6 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.85 solar masses and 5.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,840 K at its surface.
